scripts.postinstall: npm run db:generate && npm run build -w @worldpulse/shared
scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @worldpulse/shared && npm run dev -w @worldpulse/server
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @worldpulse/shared && npm run dev -w @worldpulse/web
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @worldpulse/shared && concurrently --kill-others --names server,web "npm run dev -w @worldpulse/server" "npm run dev -w @worldpulse/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @worldpulse/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.build: npm run build -w @worldpulse/shared && npm run build -w @worldpulse/server && npm run build -w @worldpulse/web
